clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter moving the family across the country in March 1952, within the year: June's homesickness and daily letters to her sister, Walter spending long hours away from home, Glen's fights at school, Walter's cutoff from his brother over their father's land money, June kept to her bed for weeks that first winter, rows between Walter and June over money for new trees, and June joining the church choir in September with her letters thinning out. The settling comes as June's anxiety eases and functioning improves with the choir.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when the frost took the crop and the bank called in the loan, within the year: Walter drinking heavily, conflict between Walter and Glen over who was to blame, Glen and Marian taking over the family's money and talks with the bank, Carl's asthma attacks worsening that winter, Nora beginning to wet the bed in April, Ida's heart trouble found in May, and Walter stopping drinking and taking work pruning other men's trees by October. The settling comes as Walter's functioning improves in the fall.

clusters.name: Glen's job loss at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen losing his job when the cannery closed in February 1975, within the year: Glen out of work most of that year sitting in the truck for hours, loud fights between Glen and Marian over money at night, Marian taking a second job cleaning offices at night, Nora stopping eating properly and losing weight, Nora keeping to her room and distancing from Marian, Walter drinking again after six years, and Nora's functioning improving as she began eating again and made the track team by June 1976. The settling comes as Nora's functioning improves and Glen finds work at the feed store.

clusters.name: Wilma moving into Nora and Hollis's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma moving into Nora and Hollis's house in January 1990, within the year: Nora clashing with Wilma over the children's bedtimes and meals, Hollis working late and keeping out of the kitchen rows, Hollis taking his mother's side, Owen having tantrums at preschool, Wilma taking over Lily's care, Nora's eczema flaring on both hands, rows between Nora and Hollis most nights, and Marian driving over twice a week to take Nora's side. The settling comes as Wilma moved to a flat in town in June 1991 and Nora's eczema cleared over the summer.
